name: What should I do to prepare my home for a new fixture installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare my home for a new fixture installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a new fixture installation, we recommend clearing the work area around the fixture, removing any personal items, and ensuring there's a clear path for our plumbers and their tools. If possible, inform family members about the upcoming work, especially regarding temporary water shut-offs. While our team will take precautions to protect your home, covering nearby furniture or flooring can provide extra protection against dust or splashes. Alpha-Plumbing Services will handle the technical aspects and cleanup of the immediate work area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, ensuring clear access for plumbers, and informing family. Covering nearby items offers extra protection.
